niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, modern mobile UI that is calm, structured, and visually intentional. This user consistently favors clear hierarchy, coherent grouping, rounded refined surfaces, and layouts with strong scanability. They often like light, airy, low-noise interfaces with restrained accents, but also sometimes respond positively to premium dark cinematic treatments when they feel cohesive and high-contrast. Across contexts, they strongly value focused task flows, reduced clutter, integrated sections, and interfaces that feel complete, productized, and contemporary rather than generic or fragmented.

criteria.description: Prefers a strong, legible hierarchy with a dominant headline, clear section flow, and reduced competition between elements.
Prefers content organized into cohesive, well-grouped modules or sections rather than fragmented mixed patterns.
Prefers interfaces with fewer competing labels, controls, ornaments, and secondary elements.
Prefers layouts with balanced whitespace, clean separation, and comfortable scanning rhythm.
Prefers rounded cards, buttons, and containers that feel soft, polished, and contemporary.
Prefers a straightforward top-to-bottom flow where sections and actions feel integrated into one continuous experience.
Prefers interfaces that feel modern, premium, productized, and intentionally designed rather than generic, template-like, or unfinished.
Prefers screens that keep attention on the main task and avoid distractions from irrelevant media or secondary modules.
Prefers a decisively prioritized primary action, with secondary actions quieter and less competitive.
Prefers labels and headings that are explicit enough to aid comprehension but integrated naturally into the content flow.
Prefers progress indicators and step cues that are compact, understated, and not visually competitive.
Prefers controls whose states and options are immediately understandable, often with explicit choices rather than ambiguous generic toggles.
Prefers icons, labels, and visual distinctions that make meaning easier to parse at a glance.
Prefers backgrounds, cards, and controls that feel tonally unified rather than pasted-on or abruptly separated.
Prefers concise or well-paced copy presentation that is easy to scan and avoids compressed, overly busy text blocks.
Prefers consistent card sizing and treatment over uneven emphasis caused by oversized panels or mismatched modules.
Prefers screens that feel fully realized and intentionally populated rather than awkwardly sparse or placeholder-like.
Prefers search fields that blend naturally into the page tone instead of popping out as detached elements.
